description: Architectural rule registry for Bizar Harness (v6.3.0, Claude Code-native). Each rule has what/why/fix fields. Rules are run by scripts/check-arch.sh.

rules.description: SDK must not import from dashboard (cross-layer violation)
rules.what: A file in packages/sdk/src/ imports from bizar-dash/.
rules.why: The SDK (Layer 0) and dashboard (Layer 1) communicate via the Claude Code MCP transport. A direct import couples the layers and breaks the SDK's portability (e.g. running inside Claude Code without the dashboard).
rules.fix: Move the shared code to packages/sdk/ and import from there. The SDK should only depend on @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk and other packages/sdk/ modules.

rules.description: SDK must not call dashboard HTTP for memory operations
rules.what: A memory tool in the SDK calls the dashboard's /api/memory HTTP endpoint.
rules.why: The SDK must work without the dashboard running. Memory is on disk at ~/.bizar_memory/ — reading/writing directly avoids a network hop and a runtime dependency.
rules.fix: Use the in-process vault helpers from packages/sdk/src/memory/index.ts (readNote, writeNote, listNotes, searchNotes).

rules.description: Plugin must not spawn `claude daemon` subprocess (Claude Code is in-process by default; use `claude --bg` for background sessions per the Claude Code CLI docs)
rules.what: Plugin or SDK code spawns the `claude daemon` subprocess unconditionally.
rules.why: Claude Code is in-process by default (no daemon). Spawning the daemon hangs in headless test environments (no claude CLI, no creds) and breaks the Agent SDK's in-process contract.
rules.fix: Embed `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` directly. If you really need a long-running background Claude Code session, opt in via `claude --bg` and a `--bg` flag the user passes explicitly. Otherwise use the MCP stdio transport from @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.

rules.description: All tools must use the Claude Code MCP tool registration shape via @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (no hand-rolled createTool wrappers from @cline/sdk)
rules.what: A tool in packages/sdk/src/mcp/ is hand-rolled instead of using the Claude Code MCP tool registration shape (was `createTool` from @cline/sdk under the Cline runtime).
rules.why: Claude Code's tool() handles inputSchema validation, the MCP tool wrapper, and metadata. Hand-rolled tools drift from the SDK contract over time and skip zod schema enforcement.
rules.fix: Import `tool` from @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk and call it with { name, description, inputSchema: z.object({...}).shape, handler }. Do not import from @cline/sdk or @cline/core.

rules.description: No debug artifacts in src/ (console.log / debugger / .only())
rules.check: ! grep -rEn '(console\\.log|debugger|\\.only\\()' packages/sdk/src plugins/bizar/index.ts --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.mjs' 2>/dev/null | grep -v test | grep -v '\\.test\\.' | head -1; true
rules.what: Debug artifact found in src/ (console.log, debugger, or .only()).
rules.why: Debug artifacts leak into production, slow down startup, and pollute logs. The clean-state check enforces their absence.
rules.fix: Remove console.log/debugger/.only(). Use logger.debug() if logging is intentional. For tests, remove .only() before commit.

rules.description: Memory vault location must be configurable via BIZAR_MEMORY_VAULT env var
rules.what: Memory vault location is hardcoded; BIZAR_MEMORY_VAULT env var not honored.
rules.why: Users may want a different vault location (e.g. project-local .obsidian/). The env var lets them override without code changes.
rules.fix: Use resolveVaultRoot() from packages/sdk/src/memory/index.ts — it checks process.env.BIZAR_MEMORY_VAULT first, then falls back to ~/.bizar_memory/.

rules.description: SDK must define the BIZAR_TOOLS tool registry with the documented surface
rules.what: Fewer than the documented number of SDK tools registered.
rules.why: The SDK ships a curated tool surface (memory, plan, kb, graph, sandbox, loop). New tools must be added to the BIZAR_TOOLS array in packages/sdk/src/mcp/server.ts.
rules.fix: Add the tool factory call inside the BIZAR_TOOLS array and import it at the top of packages/sdk/src/mcp/server.ts.
